description: TRI: Query Toxic Release Inventory annual chemical release data for a specific facility. Returns per-chemical release records with chemical name, reporting year, on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, underground injection) and their total, and the Form R one-time release quantity, newest reporting year first; page past 500 filings with offset and nextOffset. Quantities are in pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds, which TRI has facilities report in grams, are converted and marked with reportedUnit. TRI data lags ~18 months — the most recent available year is typically 2 years prior to the current calendar year. facility_id is the 15-character TRI facility ID: take it from the facilityId field of epa_tri_search_releases, or from the triFacilityIds of epa_echo_get_facility for a facility you already hold a Registry ID for. A 12-digit EPA Registry ID is a different identifier and matches no TRI records.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive). Commas, apostrophes, brackets, and Greek letters are matched as written, e.g. "4,4'-Methylenedianiline".

facility_id.description: 15-character TRI facility ID (e.g. "9867WSNRWD1981S") — the facilityId field returned by epa_tri_search_releases, or an entry of epa_echo_get_facility triFacilityIds. A 12-digit EPA Registry ID matches no TRI records.

limit.description: Maximum number of filings to return in one call (1–500, default 500). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 500 with a notice. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of filings to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

year.description: Reporting year to retrieve. Omit for all available years, newest first. TRI data is typically available through ~2 years prior to the current year.

name: epa_tri_get_facility_releases

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Present only when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unmatchable_filter`: facility_id holds a character EPA's DMAP service cannot match exactly, or chemical_name has no letter or digit. `filter_too_long`: facility_id and chemical_name make a request longer than EPA's DMAP service accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Present when truncated: the offset that continues the lookup.

limitNotice.description: Present when limit was above the cap and the call returned the cap instead.

message.description: Recovery hint when no releases are found — suggests alternative years or checking the facility ID. Absent when releases are returned.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page: present exactly when more records follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Present when a punctuated chemical_name filter read its page limit before finding every filing spelled as given, so more matching records may exist.

releases.description: Per-chemical annual TRI release records for the queried facility

items.description: Per-chemical TRI release record for this facility and year

chemicalName.description: Chemical name as reported to TRI

oneTimeReleaseInLbs.description: Form R Section 8.8 one-time release quantity in pounds (remedial actions, catastrophic events, and other one-time events not associated with production). It is already counted in the per-medium releases and the off-site transfers, so it is never added to them.

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site air releases (fugitive + stack emissions) in pounds, summed across air release types for this submission.

releasesToLandInLbs.description: On-site land releases in pounds — landfills, land treatment, surface impoundment, and other on-site disposal, summed for this submission.

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site releases via underground injection wells in pounds, summed across injection well classes for this submission.

releasesToWaterInLbs.description: On-site releases to surface water in pounds, summed across all reported outfalls for this submission.

reportedUnit.description: Present as "grams" when TRI had the facility report this chemical in grams (dioxin and dioxin-like compounds); its quantities here are converted to pounds (1 lb = 453.59237 g). Absent for chemicals reported in pounds.

totalOnSiteReleasesInLbs.description: Sum of the per-medium on-site releases present on this record (Form R Sections 5.1–5.5.4), in pounds. A medium TRI recorded only as a range code is left out, as it is from the per-medium fields; TRI's published on-site total counts a range at its midpoint, so it can be higher. Absent when no medium has a quantity.

shown.description: Number of filings returned. Present only when truncated.

truncated.description: True when more filings may follow this page; nextOffset continues it. Absent on the last page.

title: Get TRI Chemical Releases for Facility
